Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data extraction error in its analysis of the previous step. In Step 9, the WebSurfer correctly identified that "Farber's Nerve" was released on 2006-09-24 and "Ekam - Son Of Soil" was released on 2010-04-23. However, in Step 10, the Planner incorrectly swapped these dates in its "Updated Understanding" section, stating "Ekam - Son Of Soil: release date 2006-09-24" and "Farber's Nerve: release date 2010-04-23". This hallucination of swapped data led to the incorrect final conclusion that "Ekam - Son Of Soil" was released first, when the correct answer is "Farber's Nerve".
